request.subject: ICON:HUD:CANDY:EMBLEM

layers.text: Recolour as a wrapped chocolate and change no shape: the pink wrapper and its two twisted ends become caramel gold #e0a040 foil with cream highlights; the middle of the sweet is dark chocolate #4a2412 with one cream stripe round it. No pink is left. Keep every shape, thick black outline and style the same, on a transparent background.
